title: Temperature description with nested if
starterCode:
// function tempDescription(tempC) mein Celsius do
// >= 45: "Extreme heat", >=35: "Very hot", >=25: "Warm", >=15: "Pleasant", >=5: "Cool", <5: "Cold"
solution:
function tempDescription(tempC) {
  if (tempC >= 45) return "Extreme heat"
  else if (tempC >= 35) return "Very hot"
  else if (tempC >= 25) return "Warm"
  else if (tempC >= 15) return "Pleasant"
  else if (tempC >= 5) return "Cool"
  else return "Cold"
}
hints: Sabse pehle highest range check karo
Order matters — descending mein check karo
